title: Independent verification: point-set replay of κ = 0.001661202643272239
body:
This independently reconstructs and verifies the eight PR699 frame changes giving conditional **κ = 0.001661202643272239**, up from PR699's 0.001660666354374641. **Concurrent PR741 published the same construction first. This is independent verification, not a priority claim or a bound beyond PR741.**

The distinct contribution is a standard-library checker that represents subspaces as explicit subsets of the 512 points of GF(2)^9. It imports no constructor or native row-reduction code, verifies every frame inclusion, recounts the complete paid profile (including center descents and final climbs), and confirms unchanged scalar gates and helper widths. Twelve targeted controls reject omitted retimings, a mass-preserving false profile, and scalar/endpoint corruption. Strict concavity proves the direction of the cost change: each edit replaces ranks `(2,3)` by `(1,4)`.

The focused package includes an independently derived recipe, the unchanged 36,288-owner assignment, frozen native contracts, exact certificate, source pins, search coverage, contributor credits and a fresh incremental replay. It retains the original native, controller, invoice and assembly verifiers. Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`; PR699 dependency: `03e8d7ca494a083e5053cd6b1228f66b98414479`; PR635: `a6895a69f8ad98ab45777b03e9e6f48888c39f6f`. Read-only comparison pins PR741 at `e516b1463606840a15f80aac1995d64ce0092e89` and confirms identical input/output word hashes.

After the two dependency archive commands in the README:

```sh
python -B research/pr699-frame-retiming/verify.py \
  --main . --pr635 /tmp/frame8-pr635 \
  --dependency /tmp/frame8-pr699/research/gauge44-promo-p6k4sw \
  --work /tmp/frame8-verified
```

Expected: `PASS_PINNED_INPUT_FRAME_RETIMING_COMPLETE_REPLAY 0.001661202643272239`.

Validation covers all 728 columns in both orientations, 2,953 phase edges, wrappers, 35 focused frame controls, 95 inherited end controls, 12 independent frame controls, seven independent owner controls, 69 admission controls, 12 bit-supplier controls, two exact moment engines and 47 strict outer inequalities. The selected-record inventory check also passes. The replay starts from a pinned PR699 input freshly reconstructed during this investigation; it does not rebuild the ancestral chain or cited PR589 bit circuit on every invocation. Full receipts are in `research/pr699-frame-retiming-validation/`.

This remains conditional on the inherited all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, complete-call hosting, precision/tape, exact-recovery and analytic-transfer interfaces. No full theorem formalization is claimed. `upstream/` and the selected frontier are unchanged. Prepared by Tekalign with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; credits include chafreaky's concurrent PR741/owner construction, jeremykothe2/BRoute's PR699, icekylinx, BlockInvert, Q6Reviewer and the retained upstream lineages.
